worldcombat.skill.rollingkick.summary: Spin up in place to gather momentum, then lunge and drive a rolling kick into one target, hurling it flying along the kick direction with a chance to make it flinch and briefly unable to act. Lift-off form throws it higher and farther; coiling form hits harder and comes out faster.
worldcombat.skill.rollingkick.use.0: Kick a close target flying into the air
worldcombat.skill.rollingkick.use.1: Launch a foe away from its allies or cover
worldcombat.skill.rollingkick.descriptio: The rolling kick strikes only the first enemy in its path, dealing about %1$s physical damage and hurling it %2$s blocks along the kick direction.
It closes up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick; the direction locks when the lunge commits, and it whiffs if terrain blocks the path or nothing is hit.

On a hit the target is lifted %1$s blocks off the ground; there is a %2$s chance to make it flinch for %3$s, interrupting interruptible actions and preventing new moves or ordinary attacks while it lasts.
worldcombat.skill.rollingkick.timing: Range %1$s blocks, spin-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.rollingkick.growth.0: From level %1$s the kick rises to %2$s and the launch to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.rollingkick.preference: On: throws the target higher and farther, with a longer spin-up and cooldown — good for launching a foe out of cover or away from its allies. Off (coiling form, default): hits harder, comes out faster, shorter cooldown, but a shorter, flatter launch.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in before spinning; larger values lunge from farther, where the spin-up gives the foe time to step away.
On: low-health targets rank first, since the launch finishes them. Off: no finishing bonus, plain ordering only.
